title: Northgate Tire Center Package Terms Schedule: Membership, Work Orders, Appointments and Transfer
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Package Administration Terms

The terms below apply to every Northgate Tire Center package and are identical across all six packages.

| Term | Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | Northgate Tire Installation Package | Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | Northgate Premium Tire Care | Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Active membership required for installation and every later service | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Odometer recorded on every work order | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Services at any Northgate Tire Center | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Times an installation appointment can be moved | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Calendar days unmounted tires are held after a missed appointment | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Cancelled installation leaves nothing charged on the package | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Mounted tires returnable for a refund | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Package passes to a new owner of the vehicle | no | no | no | no | no | no |

## The terms in plain words

1. Installation and every later service under a package require an active membership.
2. Every work order records the vehicle's odometer, and package services are performed at any Northgate Tire Center.
3. An installation appointment can be moved at most 2 times.
4. After a missed appointment, unmounted tires are held 7 calendar days.
5. A cancelled installation leaves nothing charged on the package.
6. Tires that have been mounted cannot be returned for a refund.
7. The package does not pass to a new owner of the vehicle.
